annotations.title: Remove a recipe from my library

description: Permanently deletes one of the user's own saved recipes, such as a duplicate or a bad import. It cannot be undone, so it suits a request where the user has confirmed which recipe to delete. Catalogue recipes can't be deleted. Requires a linked Chop It account.

recipeId.description: Id of one of the user's own saved recipes (from list_saved_recipes).
